title: Closing: Basie's "mighty mice" and playing tracks from Jo Jones Plus Two
summary: Jones tells the story of Basie's slip on network radio, and Hinton plays tracks from the Jo Jones Plus Two album.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: There's the phone, Jo, hold it. In your own words, it's been mighty mice.

That's when Basie was going to the wrong dentist and he's on the network of CBS and it was very rare that a bandleader will ever speak from coast to coast. He was trying to say "mighty nice" and he said, "Don't you think it's mighty mice?" He said "mighty mice."

Oh, that's beautiful. Thank you, Jo. Hey Jo, I'd like to play a couple of tracks from your album here, the Jo Jones Plus Two on the Vanguard Studio Lab Jazz Showcase. I think the first track on here is "Satan Doll" and it shows the greatness of all of you guys with Jo Jones on drums, on here. The Jo Jones Trio/Featuring Tommy Bryant on bass and the great Ray Bryant on piano- two Philadelphia cats and a Chicago cat.
